name: kompoz
description: Kompoz's C++ sources with @Kompozable functions in Kotlin's syntax: kompozc's language server (in front of clangd) and highlighting for the Kotlin

kompoz.kompozcPath.markdownDescription: The `kompozc` to run as the language server. Empty: `KOMPOZC` from the environment, else `build/` or `cmake-build-*/compiler/kompozc` in the workspace, else `kompozc` on `PATH`.

kompoz.clangdPath.markdownDescription: The clangd that `kompozc --lsp` starts (`--clangd`). Empty: `clangd` on `PATH`.

kompoz.clangdArguments.markdownDescription: Arguments for clangd, given to `kompozc --lsp` after its own.

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test out/test/*.test.js && vscode-tmgrammar-test -g syntaxes/kompoz-cpp.tmLanguage.json -g syntaxes/kotlin.tmLanguage.json -g test/grammar/cpp.tmLanguage.json 'test/grammar/*.kompoz.cpp'
scripts.package: cp ../../LICENSE LICENSE && esbuild src/extension.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/extension.js --external:vscode --format=cjs --platform=node --target=node20 --minify && vsce package --no-dependencies
